_note: Fixture of the epic view (issue #147, claims issue #148). details is keyed owner/repo#n in lower case; variants are laid over by ?epic=<name> (nologin noaccess notfound wait stale labels empty norepo none down writesoff offline notasks). `writes` is the board's CCBOARD_EPIC_WRITES; `own_claims` are this board's own claims (held, lost). ?claim=<word> plays a refusal of the Claim button (taken lost unknown writesoff closed done attempts offline scope unconfirmed). Times are GitHub's: the page shows them against server_now, never the browser clock. Issue #149 (work): each child carries author and author_ok, and work (this board's own work record: phase running | waiting | pr | done | failed | cancelled | lost); the detail carries authors {allowed, epic, epic_ok, blocked, text} and the settings report (phase | summary | none), auto_pr, close and plan. ?epic=workrun workwait workfail workcancel plays another phase on #202; ?epic=authors marks #205 as by an author who is not allowed; ?epic=epicauthor marks the epic itself; ?epic=noauthors says no author is known. ?work=<word> plays a refusal of the Work button (the claim's words and nothere author epicauthor unreadable bypass posture lanes launch); lanes is refused until Start anyway is tapped. #205 is the row that can be worked. Issues #150 and #152 (routing): the detail carries route {can_run, blocked, running, paused, by, via, left, started_at, ended, assigned, waiting, held, ...} and, per child, route {state: assigned | waiting | held, text, node, handle, until, code} or null, and the settings max_window_pct, max_window_pct_set, group, mcp_run. ?epic=run (running: #205 sent, #206 waiting for a window, #207 held), runwait (#205 waits for a lane), runpaused, runagent (an agent started it), runfinished, runlimit, nonodes (no node paired), paused, groups (three nodes, a group, a limit, MCP on); writesoff now also blocks Run. ?run=<word> plays a refusal of Run on... for one issue (waiting claimed busy notfound); else the issue is sent to the node and shows running.
